title: Lin Tao's Study Goals and Habits
instructions: 这是为A2水平学习者编写的阅读练习。请先阅读短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
Lin Tao is a student at a small college in Nanjing. He studies English every day. He wants to improve his speaking and listening. This is his goal for this term.

A. Lin Tao has a study plan. He studies English for one hour every morning. He usually reads aloud for twenty minutes. Then he listens to short dialogues on his phone. He often writes new words in a notebook. He reviews the words before bed. He does not study late at night. He says, "I need to sleep well. Sleep helps my memory."

B. Lin Tao also has a study group. The group meets on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. There are four students in the group. They practice short conversations. Sometimes they watch a video and answer questions. Lin Tao is the group leader. He is making a schedule for next month now. He wants everyone to speak more. He asks, "Do you practice speaking at home?" One student says, "No, I don't. I only read." Lin Tao says, "You should try speaking for five minutes every day."

C. Lin Tao's teacher is Ms. Chen. She is very helpful. She often gives feedback on their speaking. She says, "Do not worry about mistakes. Speak slowly and clearly." Lin Tao is not shy. He likes to ask questions. He sometimes makes grammar mistakes, but he is not afraid. He is practicing a short talk for next week. He is working hard because he wants to do well.

Lin Tao's friends say he is a good student. He studies regularly, and he helps others. He is happy with his progress.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与 always, usually, often, sometimes, every day 等频率副词或时间状语连用。现在进行时表示现在正在进行的动作，结构是 am/is/are + 动词-ing。频率副词通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。do/does 问句用于一般现在时，主语是 I/you/we/they 时用 do，主语是 he/she/it 时用 does，动词用原形。
grammar.example: He usually reads aloud for twenty minutes. He is making a schedule for next month now. Do you practice speaking at home?

questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加 -s，所以用 gives。频率副词 often 放在实义动词前。
questions.evidence: She often gives feedback on their speaking.
